chemistry-killer-07.material: Kubushushu noxinzelelo olusemgangathweni (STP, 0 °C, 1 atm; 1 mol yegesi = 22.4 L), ingxubevange yegesi ye-methane ($\mathrm{CH_4}$) kunye ne-carbon dioxide ($\mathrm{CO_2}$) inomthamo we-11.2 L kunye nobunzima be-16.4 g. Ubunzima beeathom ngu-H = 1, C = 12, O = 16, kwaye inani lika-Avogadro yi-$N_A$. Zingaphi iiathom zizonke kule ngxubevange?
chemistry-killer-07.s.s1.prompt: Kubushushu noxinzelelo olusemgangathweni (STP, 0 °C, 1 atm; 1 mol yegesi = 22.4 L), ingxubevange yegesi ye-methane ($\mathrm{CH_4}$) kunye ne-carbon dioxide ($\mathrm{CO_2}$) inomthamo we-11.2 L kunye nobunzima be-16.4 g. Ubunzima beeathom ngu-H = 1, C = 12, O = 16, kwaye inani lika-Avogadro yi-$N_A$. Zingaphi iiathom zizonke kule ngxubevange?
chemistry-killer-07.s.s1.explain:
Inyathelo 1: Iimoli zizonke = 11.2 L / 22.4 L/mol = 0.5 mol, ngoko x + y = 0.5.
Inyathelo 2: Ubunzima: 16x + 44y = 16.4. Faka y = 0.5 - x: 16x + 22 - 44x = 16.4, ngoko 28x = 5.6, x = 0.2, y = 0.3.
Inyathelo 3: Iiathom: $\mathrm{CH_4}$ ineeathom ezi-5 kwimolekyuli nganye, 0.2 x 5 = 1.0 mol; $\mathrm{CO_2}$ ineeathom ezi-3, 0.3 x 3 = 0.9 mol. Iyonke 1.9 mol yeeathom = $1.9\,N_A$.
Iimpendulo: $1.9\,N_A$ (c). (Ezinye ezingachanekanga: i-1.5 ithatha yonke i-CO2, i-2.5 ithatha yonke i-CH4, i-1.7 ibala iiathom ezi-4 kuphela kwi-CH4.)
chemistry-killer-07.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
